tagline: Catalyst and Enabler of the Generative Economy
hero_kpi_rationale: The Revenue KPI is the Hero because it demonstrates the company's 9% growth in 2023 and reflects the accelerated adoption of the 3DEXPERIENCE platform across the 12 industries served, validating the transformation strategy toward the generative economy.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.description: The company recorded revenue growth of 9% in 2023, reflecting momentum in subscription revenue with an increase of 16% in constant currencies

kpis.name: Research and Development Investments
kpis.explanation: Research and development investments and capabilities
kpis.description: The company continues to invest in scientific approach, industrial know-how, modeling and simulation capabilities coupled with AI and data science as strategic assets for the Generative Economy
kpis.signal: Investment in innovation and modeling capabilities

kpis.name: Non-IFRS Operating Margin
kpis.description: The company achieved a non-IFRS operating margin of 32.4% in 2023 while continuing to invest in future growth and increasing headcount by 6%
kpis.signal: Strong profitability while investing in growth

kpis.name: Subscription Revenue Growth
kpis.description: Subscription revenue increased by 16% in constant currencies in 2023, demonstrating strong momentum in the recurring revenue business model
kpis.signal: Strong momentum in recurring revenue model

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total revenue of 6.24 Bn EUR last year

risks.title: Intense competition in enterprise software and PLM
risks.score_rationale: Major risk for software vendor (Item 1.9.1). Moderate language but strategic positioning is central. Stable trend but rising pressure from cloud/AI newcomers. High weight: core of business model.

risks.title: Dependency on cloud transition and SaaS adoption
risks.score_rationale: Critical strategy mentioned repeatedly (3DEXPERIENCE, SaaS, cloud). Assertive language but non-linear transition risk. Uptrend: migration underway. Very high weight: future growth model.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and protection of sensitive customer data
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned as strategic priority ('cyber-software'). Strong language: 'trust', 'sovereign legacy', 'strategic data'. Uptrend: customer data increasingly sensitive (healthcare, defense, energy). Critical weight: key differentiator.

risks.title: Intellectual property and technological innovation
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned as 'most powerful competitive asset'. Strong language on IP and modeling/simulation. Stable trend but rising pressure from open-source AI. High weight: product differentiation.

risks.title: Sovereignty regulation and export controls
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned: 'scope of sovereignty expanded to energy, materials, defense, health data'. Strong language on 'sovereign legacy'. Uptrend: rising geopolitical factors. High weight: strategic customers.

risks.title: Dependency on large customers and commercial concentration
risks.score_rationale: Not explicitly detailed in Item 1.9 provided, but implicit: '350,000 customers' but focus on 'large commercial agreements' and 12 industries. Stable trend. Moderate weight: classic software vendor risk.

risks.title: Post-acquisition integration and talent retention
risks.score_rationale: Acquisition history mentioned (timeline, subsidiaries). Neutral language. Stable trend but ongoing acquisitions. Moderate weight: significant inorganic growth.

risks.title: AI and data science talent and capabilities
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned: 'AI engines', 'data science', 'upskilling workforce'. Assertive language but intense competition. Uptrend: AI critical. Moderate weight: scarce resource.
